findings.effect: The search returns false as soon as it pops a step with no precedents, even when other branches remain in pending. This lets cycles through when such a branch is explored before the branch that loops back.

The proposal card only includes precedents when there is exactly one, hiding dependencies when a new step has two or more even though the planner saves them. Users would approve dependencies they never saw, affecting both add_step and steps nested in add_section.
